# truenas_container (Data Source)

Looks up an LXC container on TrueNAS by name (container.query). Requires TrueNAS 26.0 or later (see the truenas_container resource's schema description for the version-gate details). Note "pool" is recovered from the container's dataset path rather than returned directly by the API; "image" is not exposed here at all — the API never echoes back the image a container was created from (see truenas_container's schema description).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Container name to look up.

### Read-Only

- `autostart` (Boolean)
- `capabilities_policy` (String)
- `capabilities_state` (Map of Boolean)
- `cpuset` (String)
- `dataset` (String) ZFS dataset backing the container's root filesystem.
- `default_network` (String)
- `description` (String)
- `id` (Number) Numeric container ID.
- `idmap` (String) Idmap configuration as a JSON-encoded string.
- `init` (String)
- `initdir` (String)
- `initenv` (Map of String)
- `initgroup` (String)
- `inituser` (String)
- `pool` (String) ZFS pool backing the container's root dataset, recovered from "dataset".
- `running` (Boolean)
- `shutdown_timeout` (Number)
- `status` (String) Current container status: RUNNING, STOPPED.
- `time` (String)
- `uuid` (String) Container UUID.
